=== Usage ===
Adds a soundbutton with each IPA symbol, when the soundfile is available. Takes a big space, as the soundbox is less flexible by your browser.

===Technical notes===
Used subtemplate: {{tlx|IPA pulmonics audio/soundbox}}, which in turn calls {{tlx|IPA soundbox}}.

Parameters are:
<pre>{{IPA pulmonics audio/soundbox
|
| soundfile=
| showsymbol=
}}</pre>

: 1= IPA symbol (expected to be in the {{tl|IPAsym}} list). {{tlx|IPAsym|p}} &rarr; {{IPAsym|p}}.ogg.
: soundfile  = filename that overrules the default filename from IPAsym.
: showsymbol = character that is shown instead of the IPA symbol that is used in the first parameter.
